steps.title: Charge
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Micro II with USB-C charging cable

bullets.text: Plug **any USB-C cable** into the port on the device.
Give it a full charge before first use.

steps.title: Load
steps.imageAlt: Micro II mouthpiece removed, ceramic chamber open for loading

bullets.text: **Remove the mouthpiece** to access the ceramic heating chamber.
**Load** the chamber with your concentrate — do not overfill.

note.text: A small amount of concentrate goes a long way. Overfilling can clog the chamber and reduce airflow.

steps.title: Activate
steps.imageAlt: Micro II power button and temperature settings display

press.sub: Hold to heat while you draw, up to 25 seconds

note.text: Lower temperatures preserve flavor terpenes. Higher temperatures produce bigger, more intense vapor.

steps.title: Clean
steps.imageAlt: Cleaning the Micro II ceramic heating chamber with a cotton swab

bullets.text: **Allow the device to completely cool** before cleaning.
Clean **inside the ceramic heating chamber** and the mouthpiece — ensure air holes are clear.
Allow the device to **completely dry** before using again.

note.text: **Never soak the battery** in alcohol or any liquid.

steps.title: Alerts
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Micro II LED indicator light

bullets.text: **G logo flashing** = No atomizer detected — check that the mouthpiece is fully seated.
**G logo flashing** = Atomizer short circuit — remove and reattach the mouthpiece; contact support if it continues.

attachments.title: Sidecar
attachments.imageAlt: Micro II with the Sidecar glass attachment lifted off its silicone adapter

bullets.text: Remove the mouthpiece and attach via the **included silicone adapter**.
Control airflow with the **built-in carb hole**.
The **showerhead percolator** filters and cools vapor for smoother sessions.

attachments.title: Rig Adapter
attachments.imageAlt: Micro II with the Rig Adapter and its 14mm glass stem lifted off

bullets.text: Remove the mouthpiece and attach the **Rig Adapter**, then connect 14 mm glass to a compatible glass rig.
Control airflow with the **built-in carb hole**.
The **L-shape design** gives maximum flexibility when connected to a rig.

specs.label: Compatible attachments
specs.value: Sidecar, Rig Adapter (14 mm) — sold separately

faq.question: Nothing happens when I press the button
faq.answer: Press the button five times quickly to turn the device on. The LED will light up when it is powered on. If it still doesn't respond, charge the device first.

faq.question: Which temperature should I use?
faq.answer: Start at ~295°F for the most flavorful, terpene-rich experience. Step up to ~340°F for a balance of flavor and vapor. Use ~395°F for maximum vapor production.

faq.question: The G logo keeps flashing
faq.answer: A flashing G logo means either no atomizer is detected or there is an atomizer short circuit. Remove the mouthpiece completely, reattach it firmly, and try again. If it continues flashing, contact G Pen support.

faq.question: How do I use the device with a glass rig?
faq.answer: Remove the mouthpiece from the Micro II and attach the Rig Adapter (sold separately). Connect 14mm glass to your compatible glass rig for water-cooled vapor.

faq.question: How often should I clean the chamber?
faq.answer: Clean the ceramic heating chamber after every few sessions to maintain performance. Let the device cool fully, then use a cotton swab with ISO to wipe the chamber and mouthpiece, and dry completely before use.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
faq.answer: The Micro II comes with a **6-Month Limited Warranty**, or a **1-Year Limited Warranty** when you register your device at gpen.com. Read the full terms on gpen.com, or contact support with your order details.
